caveats: Windows msvcrt locking, directory fsync, reparse attributes, and inode identity are implemented portably but remain unverified on native Windows.
Helper never redacts credential-looking memory; root TS must redact previews before UI exposure or approval.
Pending JSON extra/unknown keys fail closed as unsupported; if native stage_write grows fields, the allowlist must be extended.
memory.provider / memory_provider / backend must be absent or exactly builtin; other providers are unsupported rather than guessed.
Config is read only from {profile}/config.yaml with duplicate-key rejection; fail-open load_config / load_on_disk_store / load_config_readonly are never used.
Preview is held (no digest) for blocked-content, unsupported, disabled, and unsafe-storage, so decide CAS cannot approve or reject those items; pending bytes are preserved.
A pending that cannot dry-run against current memory (match/budget/drift) cannot be preview-bound; reject also requires that successful preview digest.
tools.memory_tool import is silenced on stdio and may still run registry side effects; this helper does not load auth or call a provider.
Python import may follow module files under runtimeDirectory; the runtime directory itself is rejected if it is a symlink/reparse.
Helper-owned .realbud-memory-reviews is 0700/0600; native memories/pending directories may be 755 and are not encrypted or wiped.
Host must kill the helper on timeout and must not treat a missing/timeout process as completed; ok:true is emitted only after durable receipt and pending resolution.
Delimiter and control-character checks are extra fail-closed guards; matching, budget, and apply semantics come only from a dry-run MemoryStore plus apply_memory_pending.
Whole-file round-trip and duplicate gates refuse silent dict.fromkeys drops and foreign content before native closures run; preview does not write .bak.
HERMES_HOME and get_memory_dir() must match the host profile path or the helper returns unavailable.
List is 20/page over sorted 8hex ids with a combined 2000 directory-record cap; leftover .tmp.* files are preserved.
Receipts store only binding digests, metadata, decision, before/after digests, and phase — never memory text — and are workspace/profile/runtime MAC-bound.
Batch new_text is normalized to content before threat validation; conflicting aliases are rejected. apply_memory_pending's single-op path does not alias new_text natively.
summary/detail/ACP prose is never parsed as typed operations.
Lock order is always profile review lock then native MemoryStore._file_lock on the target; dry-run I/O is lock-free so native _mutate is not nested.
Unresolved intent plus config/runtime change is held even if current bytes still equal before; opposite decisions and pending-digest collisions stay held.

Native MemoryStore._write_file is used for the real apply, then the helper fsyncs the resulting file and directory before the applied receipt. No-op approvals still write a final receipt before pending removal.
profileId must equal the profile directory basename; charLimit is bounded 1..100000 with native defaults 2200/1375 when those keys are absent.
write_approval must be present and truthy in the memory mapping; missing memory_enabled / user_profile_enabled follow native defaults (true) via get_builtin_memory_store_flags.
